title: 돈이 천 원밖에 없어요: '밖에'로 '이것뿐' 말하기
objective: By the end, you can use N + 밖에 with 없어요, 안, or 못 to say "only (and that is not much)." You can also change a sentence with 만 into one with 밖에.
summary: This worksheet teaches the particle 밖에 ("only, no more than"), which always comes with a negative such as 없어요, 안, or 못, and compares it with 만.

task.title: Use 밖에 correctly
task.line: Choose, fill in, correct, or write the Korean as each instruction asks.

forms.when: Use it to say you have only a small amount of something. 밖에 has one form: it attaches straight to the noun, with or without a final consonant.
forms.means: there is only ~ / I only have ~ (less than you want)
forms.exampleMeaning: There's only milk in the fridge.

forms.when: Use it when you did only a little of something by choice, or when the amount was simply small.
forms.exampleMeaning: I only slept three hours last night.

forms.when: Use it when you can't do more, even if you want to.
forms.means: can only ~ (not able to do more)
forms.example: 저는 한국 노래를 하나밖에 못 불러요.
forms.exampleMeaning: I can only sing one Korean song.

forms.when: 만 goes with a positive verb, and 밖에 goes with a negative one. Both mean "only," but 밖에 adds the feeling "that's not much."
forms.means: only ~ (밖에 sounds like "just this, nothing more")
forms.example: 점심에 김밥만 먹었어요. = 점심에 김밥밖에 안 먹었어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: I only ate gimbap for lunch.

watchOut: 돈이 천 원밖에 있어요 (X) → 돈이 천 원밖에 없어요 (O): 밖에 always needs a negative (없어요, 안, 못).
커피만 안 마셔요 (X) → 커피밖에 안 마셔요 (O): This is wrong if you mean "I only drink coffee." 만 + 안 means "I drink everything except coffee."
천 원 밖에 없어요 (X) → 천 원밖에 없어요 (O): Write 밖에 with no space after the noun. With a space, 밖에 means "outside" (집 밖에 = outside the house).
주스를밖에 안 마셔요 (X) → 주스밖에 안 마셔요 (O): Drop 을/를 and 이/가 before 밖에.
exercises: Choose the correct verb: ① 주말에 한 시간밖에 (공부했어요 / 공부 안 했어요). ② 주말에 한 시간만 (공부했어요 / 공부 안 했어요).
Fill in 만 or 밖에 so that both sentences mean "My younger sibling eats only vegetables": ① 동생은 채소____ 먹어요. ② 동생은 채소____ 안 먹어요.
Fill in 안 or 못: ① 더 걷고 싶었는데 다리가 아파서 조금밖에 ____ 걸었어요. ② 배가 안 고파서 일부러 밥을 반밖에 ____ 먹었어요.
Find the mistake and write the correct words: ① 지금 시간이 십 분밖에 있어요. ② 저는 동생이 한 명 밖에 없어요.
Rewrite the sentence with 밖에: 오늘 친구를 한 명만 만났어요.
Answer in Korean with 밖에. You learned Korean for 6 months: A: 한국어를 얼마나 배웠어요? B: ____
answers: ① 공부 안 했어요 ② 공부했어요
① 십 분밖에 없어요 ② 한 명밖에 없어요
오늘 친구를 한 명밖에 안 만났어요. (Also correct: 한 명밖에 못 만났어요, if you couldn't meet more.)
육 개월밖에 안 배웠어요. (Also correct: 6개월밖에 안 배웠어요 / 여섯 달밖에 안 배웠어요.)
